prompts.name: garden
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: large resort website garden photograph.
Input image 1 is the edit target and visual reference: the actual garden at The Nature Nest resort.
Primary request: faithfully regenerate this pixelated photograph with crisp, believable photographic detail, retaining the same garden and property. Improve image quality, not the resort design.
Preserve the bright green lawn; young palms and other tropical shrubs; the irregular stepping-stone path leading toward two small cream-and-red cottages in the left and middle background; the rustic log arch covered with climbing greenery and white flowers, its hanging small brass bell, and wooden platform on the right; the dark irregular-stone support at the right edge; the black garden lamp posts; and tall established trees behind. Keep the same relationship and placement of these features.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 photograph framed around the central lawn, background cottages and rustic arch. Recompose the existing central scene from the reference for a landscape website card, excluding most of the excess empty sky and extreme bottom foreground. Retain enough garden at the sides for the complete arch and cottages. Natural eye-level camera view.
Lighting and texture: soft natural daylight, a lightly overcast sky, realistic grass blades, leaf detail, vine blossoms, log grain and stone texture. Sharp, clear photographic detail with balanced exposure and realistic greens. Request highest available resolution.
Constraints: preserve the real modest property, architecture and landscaping. No people, no new structures or furnishings, no pool, no fantasy landscaping, no added signs, text, logos or watermark. Avoid oversaturation, artificial sharpening, painterly textures and CGI aesthetic.

prompts.name: cottages
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: large resort website cottage photograph.
Input image 1 is the edit target and visual reference: the actual Nature Nest cottages.
Primary request: regenerate the same photograph with clear high-resolution photographic detail, removing pixelation and muddy shadows while preserving the exact buildings and setting.
Preserve the two adjacent cream-colored narrow cottages, their red pitched roof edging, red brick-pattern lower side walls, large triangular-topped upper glass windows with beige vertical curtains, dark framed ground-floor sliding glass doors with patterned curtains, dense dark-green palms in the foreground and between the buildings, wooden deck paths along the bottom and sides, trees behind, and the visible red horizontal pipe across the gap. Keep the original proportions, number of storeys, window geometry, door placement, composition and perspective. Keep the left building fully visible and the right building larger/closer as in the reference.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9 image with both cottage facades clearly visible, the greenery filling the lower foreground and natural sky around the tree tops. Architectural photography, straight believable verticals.
Lighting: natural soft morning daylight, gentle warm cream walls, clearer but still realistic shadows under the palms, detailed glass reflections and fabric curtains. Resolve leaf texture, brick joints and wood grain naturally without excessive HDR or sharpening. Request highest available resolution.
Constraints: no people, no new architecture, no added balconies, furniture, amenities or signage, no altered building colors or luxury redesign, no text, logos or watermark. Photorealistic and faithful to the existing property, not CGI or an illustration.
